clips.title: The story
paras: Ironband's Excavation Site is an expansive dwarven dig located in southeastern Loch Modan, just south of the lake and southwest of Farstrider Lodge. Led by Prospector Ironband, the archaeological operation was abruptly halted when aggressive, volatile troggs overran the trenches.

Spurred by the dwarven drive to uncover their ancient Titan origins, Prospector Ironband established this sprawling digsite along the rugged cliffs of southeastern Loch Modan. What began as a promising excavation quickly turned into a disaster when the digging disturbed an unusually fierce and large breed of subterranean troggs. The creatures surged from the earth, driving back the miners and setting up camp amidst the scattered tools, broken carts, and half-excavated relics.
